capabilities: Defer Reading view redraws until window resizing settles
Combine repeated intermediate resize updates into one final update
Leave note content and Editing view untouched during the drag
extras: Desktop only (requires Obsidian 1.13.4+); uses an internal Reading view resize callback not exposed by the public API, so Obsidian updates may require a compatibility update. No settings, network requests, or telemetry.
intentEvidence: it only avoids repeating the same expensive work for sizes that are immediately superseded
motivation: The author traced the slowdown in a real 150 KB chapter and wanted resizing to feel immediate without changing how notes look or how Obsidian works after the drag.
problem: Resizing the desktop window with a long note open in Reading view triggers repeated expensive recalculations that make the drag feel sluggish.
summary: Performance plugin that delays Reading view redraws during window resizing so long notes resize responsively.
